craft_notes: Sthāyin: author's seal (lineage bowed, fifteen uttered). Rows: row 2 (bowed→uttered). Close: Abhinavagupta (the NAME lands last: authorship as the tantra's final word). Rejected: anonymizing — kept the name (colophon honesty; v16 IS the attribution); 'composed' — kept uttered (īrita as spoken, not written).

lines: Bowing first to perfected guides, gods, goddess, then the seeing ones —
these fifteen verses were uttered by Abhinavagupta.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pūrvasiddhān gurūn devān devīṃ natvātha yoginaḥ | ime'bhinavaguptena ślokāḥ pañcadaśeritāḥ
